Все акции рынка на одном экране в виде п: Every stock on the market on one screen, as tiles.
Tile size is the company's market cap. Colour shows the price change over the selected period: green for gains, red for losses. Colour intensity scales with the size of the move.
Количество открытых позиций по инструмен: Number of open positions in an instrument.
Движение денег в российских биржевых фон: Money flows in Russian exchange-traded funds.
Стоимость активов фонда и её изменение в: Fund net asset value and how it changes over time. Funds are grouped by asset class: equities, bonds, gold, currencies and others. Charts show NAV dynamics and inflows/outflows over the period.
The list of securities and their weight in the fund's portfolio. Data comes from official asset-manager disclosures. The page shows donut charts and holdings tables.
Оценка рынка через отношение к экономике: Market valuation relative to the size of the economy.
Суммарная капитализация публичных компан: Total market cap of public companies divided by GDP. Below 50% is considered cheap, above 100% expensive. The chart shows the ratio in percent and the valuation zones.
Share of stocks trading above their moving average.
Показывает какой процент акций индекса с: Shows what percentage of index stocks currently trade above their moving average. The higher the value, the broader the rally across the market. The chart shows the current value and its history.
Average price change by period of the year.
Средняя и медианная динамика цены по дня: Mean and median price dynamics by day of week, month and year. Charts show bars of average change per period and a price chart by year.
Главные показатели рынка на одной страни: Key market indicators on one page.
Ключевые котировки, настроение рынка, ли: Key quotes, market sentiment, top gainers and losers, sector and fund moves. Updates automatically during trading hours.
Кто покупает, кто продаёт на бирже по ка: Who is buying and who is selling on the exchange, by participant type.
Среднемесячные нетто-покупки и нетто-про: Average monthly net purchases and net sales by participant type: non-residents, banks, retail investors, funds and others. Positive values are purchases, negative are sales. Source: the Bank of Russia's monthly Financial Market Risks Review.
